paper_title: Defending Against Social Engineering Attacks in the Age of LLMs
caption: Inter-annotator agreement compared to sample-level ambiguity standard deviation and sample-level maximum ambiguity values.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the relationship between Fleiss Kappa and ambiguity metrics. The horizontal axis represents categories labeled “Ambiguity Std” with values 0.0, 0.47, 0.82, and 0.94 in the left chart, and “Max Ambiguity” with values 1, 2, and 3 in the right chart, ordered numerically. The vertical axis is labeled “Fleiss Kappa” and represents values ranging from 0.0 to 0.9, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. The left chart displays three teal bars corresponding to the ambiguity standard deviation values, with heights reaching approximately 0.88 (for 0.0), 0.46 (for 0.47), and 0.24 (for 0.94). The right chart displays three teal bars corresponding to the max ambiguity values, with heights reaching approximately 0.89 (for 1), 0.46 (for 2), and 0.23 (for 3). Each bar is labeled with its corresponding Fleiss Kappa value above the bar. The bars are not visually emphasized beyond their color and height.
